features: Up to 54TB storage (3 x 18TB), hot-swappable removable bays
USB: front 1 x USB 2.0, rear 4 x USB 3.0; 1 x RS-232
Windows 11 IoT LTSC (24H2) or Debian 11 GNU/Linux (-LINUX); VIGIL VMS v7.5+ (Windows), v12.60.0400+ (Linux)
Supported video codecs: MJPEG, MPEG-4, H.264, H.264+, H.265
IP PTZ support; multi-streaming support; IP audio support
Recording modes: motion, alarm, audio, analytics; audio OggVorbis 16 Kbps
Edge-based analytics: people counting, tripwire, loitering alarms
Third-party integrations: access control, alarm, ATM, POS, time/attendance
notes: Storage: 2026 datasheet title states 18TB max storage, its body states up to 54TB (3 x 18TB); 2022 spec sheet gives 2TB to 12TB per bay and up to 54TB. Per-bay maximum left out.
Max MP support: 2026 datasheet gives 480MP; 2022 spec sheet gives 320MP.
OS drive: 2026 datasheet gives 256GB M.2 NVMe SSD; 2022 spec sheet gives 128GB SSD.
2026 datasheet title mentions hybrid (IP or analog) camera support but lists no analog inputs for this model; the hybrid versions are HVR-2U-64CH-16 and HVR-2U-64CH-16-HD.

USB: 2026 datasheet gives 1 front USB 2.0 and 4 rear USB 3.0, and its key features list a front USB 3.0 port; 2022 spec sheet gives "1 Front USB 2.0; 6 Rear - 4x USB3.0". Total USB port count left out.
